## Why
One Claude starting a tool or exiting can erase a sibling’s waiting signal. Bypass questions and flags also disappear from attention surfaces the operator relies on. Backlog item: A1.

## Evidence
- c11 on origin/main (`0ff8887e5e`): `CLI/c11.swift:16852`, `:16934`, `:17042` send workspace-wide clears; `Sources/WorkspaceManager.swift:1223` does the same during stale-PID cleanup (the report cites the adjacent comment at 1222). `Sources/TerminalNotificationStore.swift:1216` already has a workspace-and-surface clear seam.
- `CLI/c11.swift:17006-17040` saves AskUserQuestion then trusts a subsequent Notification; ExitPlanMode falls through to working. `Sources/AppDelegate.swift:13869-13896` builds the menu-bar snapshot from notifications only. Flags use the separate mutation/delivery path at `Sources/AttentionModel.swift:398-429`.
- `Sources/TerminalNotificationStore.swift:510-530` exports only CMUX_NOTIFICATION_TITLE/SUBTITLE/BODY; direct flag custom-command execution follows banner success at `:1316-1333`.
- Upstream: cmux #6608 / issue #6606; `CLI/cmux.swift:29701-29730` on upstream/main (`920ff39ff7`) identifies AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode at PreToolUse in bypass mode.
- Research: `upstream-triage/c11-1.0/03-feed-attention.md`, “Bugs a Feed would expose”; report 04 question 3 and “What c11 has today”; Fable §2 Feed F0 / Phone P0; Astra §2 Feed F0 / Phone P0. BACKLOG A1 and D25 govern delivery in 1.0.

## Scope
In: all four scoped-clear sites, bypass question/plan waiting, menu-bar visibility for flags, and Notification Command target/kind environment variables. Keep these as one bounded attention bug batch.
Out: typed Feed store/UI (A2/A4), shared ordering/open-ask count (A3), producer expansion/journal (J2/J3), phone forwarding, banner answers, menu-key approval, screen classification and separate point releases.

## Approach
Resolve the originating tab once and use the existing scoped clear. The stale-PID map is workspace-scoped: establish a reliable tab association before cleanup, and leave unrelated notices intact when no association exists. Create the bypass attention signal from the existing async hook; normal-mode follow-up notifications must not duplicate it. Have the menu bar observe TabAttentionIndex without inserting flags into routine notification history. Add C11_NOTIFICATION_WORKSPACE_ID, C11_NOTIFICATION_TAB_ID and C11_NOTIFICATION_KIND to both routine and direct flag command paths, with equivalent CMUX_* aliases and existing TITLE/SUBTITLE/BODY compatibility. Document the actual banner-authorization dependency; adding IDs is not a phone-delivery guarantee. J3 must reuse this repair, not reimplement it.

## Acceptance criteria
1. With two waiting agents in one workspace, run prompt-submit, ordinary pre-tool-use, session-end and stale-PID cleanup for one agent separately; only its eligible notice clears, and the sibling’s unread/waiting state survives each case.
2. In recorded bypass-mode AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode runs, the originating unsuppressed tab enters waiting without PermissionRequest/Notification. A normal-mode follow-up notification yields one attention item. Closing/responding clears only that tab.
3. A raised flag appears in the enabled menu-bar extra even with zero routine unread notices; a suppressed flagged tab still appears. Lowering removes it, and suppressed unflagged completions remain quiet.
4. A capture command receives the correct workspace UUID, tab UUID and kind for a routine notice and a flag; C11 and CMUX aliases agree. Workspace-only notices have an explicit absent-tab representation rather than a guessed focused tab. Existing CMUX text variables remain available.
5. The above actions do not activate c11 or change the operator’s selected tab. Existing root-thread rejection (C11-189) and suppression behavior continue to pass their incident fixtures.

## Validation
Use F3’s sibling-clear and bypass fixtures through executable hook/store paths, plus a fake Notification Command executable to capture its environment. Run tests_v2 against a tagged socket and a computer-use pass for the menu bar with c11 both frontmost and backgrounded. Run a targeted multi-agent notification churn soak against the F2 typing-latency baseline; do not replace these with source-text assertions.

Builds and soaks run on Atlas once F1 / C11-216 lands, through the build lock. Use a tagged artifact and its socket, launched with C11_QA_LAUNCH=fresh (or the tagged automation launcher); never an untagged DEV app. Record exact artifact/head and distinguish fixture assertions from the real product pass. Update affected CLI/event skill contracts, run scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh for edited installable skills and verify the installed copy.

## Dependencies
Depends on F3 for the recorded regression oracle; the fixes themselves do not require the journal. F1 / C11-216 supplies build/soak capacity. A3 builds on this menu-bar fix. J3 must retain this bypass behavior; J6 / C11-231 owns reason-bearing lifecycle events.

## Risks
An unknown stale PID must not be guessed onto a sibling tab. Async hook arrival can expose the known late-PreToolUse incident: keep the repair bounded to the captured cases and leave journal ordering to J2. Follow the C11-188 AAR and escalate after three non-converging review cycles. Keep telemetry parsing, I/O, deduplication and sorting off main; apply only the minimal UI mutation asynchronously. Preserve the hitTest pointer guard, TabItemView equality boundary and allocation-free forceRefresh path. No tenant config writes or trust broadening. Localize new product strings in English plus ja, uk, ko, zh-Hans, zh-Hant and ru; validate interpolation tokens. Sanitize fixtures, screenshots and logs before inclusion in this public repository.

Size: M. Tier: P0. Doctrine check: optional per-process observation and explicit operator actions only; no blocking bridge, automatic approval or persistent tenant configuration.

Stale-PID cleanup uses the explicit association for the registered PID; absent or replaced attribution cannot select a sibling. The existing workspace status-key model remains bounded as planned.
- AC2: bypass AskUserQuestion and plan/bypass ExitPlanMode publish a targeted notice. Normal AskUserQuestion retains its Notification path; the existing store replacement leaves one item for that workspace/tab. The native plan-mode extension is tied to the recorded incident, rather than a new lifecycle mechanism.
- AC3: the menu observes the attention index, includes suppressed flags at zero routine unread, refreshes on lowering, and keeps flags outside routine history. Suppressed unflagged notifications are excluded from its signal view. Flag navigation uses the exact workspace/tab; routine read/clear actions do not lower flags.
- AC4: routine and direct-flag command paths carry their original IDs and kind; both prefixes agree and absent tab overwrites inherited attribution with an empty string. Existing text variables and authorization/banner-success dependency remain intact.
- AC5: scoped-clear parsing is worker-owned; mutations queue to main without activation or selection changes. New menu navigation is an explicit user action. No new epochs, fences, markers, coordinator, tenant-config writes, or typing-path changes appear.

C11-257 #493/#494/#497 and C11-271 are ancestors of this head. The Stop mailbox-drain branch, wrappers, Mailbox, Messages and send-recording paths have no candidate changes. No regression was identified in their shared dispatch seam; runtime CI remains separately gated.
